base: Use case: ui-mockup. Produce ONE polished horizontal desktop website section for PNPLINE Chinese logistics home, part of a coherent 10-section concept. Not a poster, not a device mockup, no surrounding presentation labels. EXACT CANVAS 1920 x 1080 pixels. Content strictly between x=240 and x=1680, giving 240px empty side gutters and a 1440px content area. Background color may fill gutters but all graphics, text, links stay inside. At least 140px top/bottom breathing room except header. Premium industrial editorial aesthetic derived from attached lime/charcoal container ads and video: photoreal steel cargo objects over flat geometric lime directional ribbons with rounded diagonal notches, huge intentional Chinese typography and spacious precise editorial layout. Palette consistent: warm ivory #F7F9F2, charcoal #191B1A, acid lime #BCFF00, steel gray. Existing logo is cyan #00ABE1 and gray; retain those original logo colors, use cyan nowhere else. Simplified Chinese sans akin Source Han Sans/Noto Sans SC, strong size hierarchy: H1 88-96px heavy, H2 58-64px bold, item titles 28-32px semibold, body 22-24px regular generous 1.6 leading, captions 18px minimum. Compact small labels only in restrained amounts. Do not fill empty space with tiny copy. 40-64px internal group gaps, 32px element gaps, fine rules, modest 20-28px corners. No gradients, no UI glass, no fake statistics, no invented client logos or badges, no lorem ipsum or random English. Copy below is exact or faithfully shorten only descriptive text if needed; retain ALL required items. Generated logistical illustration must be explicitly captioned 概念示意; never imply it proves real PNPLINE facilities. Separate section only, do not render other page sections. Reference jpgs are STYLE references only, never copy their text, watermarks or logos. Supplied PNP-LINE.webp is the actual logo insert, reproduce accurately only if section calls for logo.

sections.detail: SECTION 1 HERO with integrated site header. Ivory background. Use 18px nav spacing, preserve legibility within grid. Main hero is an editorial image-as-canvas composition; NOT standard left text right image. Large two-line headline at x240 y235: 美国自营海外仓 / 与订单履约. First line charcoal, second charcoal. Thin eyebrow PNPLINE · 跨境物流服务 above. A realistic silver freight container hangs on crane cables, low 3/4 view, occupies central-lower-right x860..1640 y360..800. Behind it a sculptural flat huge lime bent directional ribbon/notched block, with subtle realistic ground shadow; reference image composition. Nothing overlaps headline glyphs. Lower-left block at x240 y585 width550: 从中国出货，衔接美国自营仓与配送 as 30px semibold, then 24px body: 依托PNPLINE美国自营仓，围绕一件代发、FBA中转补货、头程运输与进口清关咨询，梳理适合您的物流方案。 Below charcoal filled CTA 免费获取报价 ↗ and secondary text 查看美国自营仓库 ↗. Small underlined 了解服务 ↓ at y955. Small 概念示意 beneath container. Airy, ambitious campaign visual, clear Chinese copy, exact 240px margins.

No full bleed of lime ribbon. H2 at x240 y160 two lines 看清货物从中国到美国的每一步. Body 从出货资料到美国境内配送，先确认各阶段需要衔接的工作。 A wide horizontal editorial sequence of 5 realistic miniature matte silver cargo objects at y400..620: factory with cartons; container ship; plain paper manifest/folder no certification seals; warehouse bay and lime forklift; delivery truck. Use a thin black directional route threading all five, nodes numbered 01..05. Node 04 is strongest with lime notched backdrop. Five aligned columns below imagery at y700, each max250px wide; exact headings 01 中国工厂, 02 头程运输, 03 美国清关, 04 美国自营海外仓, 05 美国境内配送. Descriptions respectively 整理商品、包装与出货资料。 / 评估整柜、拼箱或空运。 / 核对申报资料、IOR需求与各方责任。 / 衔接入库验收、库存管理与出库作业。 / 对接FBA补货、订单配送或B2B交付。 Footnote 具体路线、服务范围与时效，以确认后的物流方案为准。 and 概念示意. Calm informative diagram, generous negative space, avoid map or geographic claims. Same material and type as previous hero, but radically different layout.

SECTION 5 OPERATION AND SYSTEM TRUST. Return to airy ivory background. Small bottom note 可用功能、账号权限和数据更新方式，以实际系统为准。 NO warehouse photo, NO certificate badge, NO fabricated operational proof, NO place names. Consistent lime notched corner once on WMS panel, ample breathing space.

SECTION 6 CUSTOMS INFORMATION, MINI MINIMALIST quiet interlude. Only one short section. Outer background ivory. Centered 1440px wide low banner y230..820, flat acid lime panel with rounded diagonal notch on upper right, generous inner padding90. All foreground must remain inside x240..1680. Small eyebrow 发货前的准备. Headline 先了解进口清关的服务范围, split naturally in 2 lines, 68px bold left within panel.
